# consent-ledger

> Append-only consent records per subject and purpose with policy versions, point-in-time status, stale consent detection, idempotent events and JSON export Python package `trysac-consent-ledger`, import name `consent_ledger`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
